sourceCensus.cause: Both lookup hooks expose error/refetch, but this consumer reads only lists/loading. Failed first reads map missing data to empty arrays with loading false; the stale-selection effect clears valid selected IDs.
consumers: Service input: environmentId:form.environmentId || undefined at create-service-input.ts:196
Key Value create: environmentId ?? undefined at keyvalue.new.tsx:127
Postgres create: environmentId ?? undefined at create-database-dialog.tsx:170
sourceCensus.scope: Five App creation types share one service mount; PG/KV share the same selector via their own local state. Failure probes and real create were web only; all five App types had healthy desktop/mobile preview controls.

framework.name: @apollo/client
framework.mechanism: Under errorPolicy all the result can expose failed read data and an error with loading false. Local hooks map absent lists to []; the selector's error-blind effect is the application defect.

screenshot.scope: Both selected-placement controls and existing explanatory hint, no credentials.

limits: Failures were deliberately substituted in this browser only; do not claim a production backend outage.
PG/KV read-error behavior, warm-cache failures, partial field-null errors, transport/timeout classes and explicit choice during a pending read remain audit/test work.
Pending blank labels were observed, but no separate layout/latency finding is asserted.
Initial sparse REST placement projection did not establish null placement; the full independent GraphQL SavedPlacement receipt is the proof.
One early Project confirmation capture timed out before any DeleteProject request; readback confirmed this before one successful actual deletion. No second product finding is asserted.
